messages:
Maya: Heads-up — AlphaBank reached out with a hard ask: 10-year audit-log retention, BYOK using their EU KMS, tenant-level legal-hold toggles, and exportable immutable evidence for SOC2. They want a commercial commitment before EOY Q2. Can we triage scope and launch criteria?
Alex: wow, ok. quick Q: do they need full-text search over 10y or just exportable snapshots?
Paul (Sales): they said searchable for investigations, but would accept export->search if cost/latency makes live search infeasible. They also signalled budget for a dedicated package.
Sam (Security): BYOK in EU + legal hold = several compliance controls: key residency + audit of key usage, encrypted-at-rest separation, and proof of immutability for exports. Need to confirm KMS product (Cloud KMS vs HSM).
Dina (Legal): For legal hold we need chain-of-custody metadata (who exported, when, checksum), preservation of originals, and redactability rules for PII. Also want a verifiable manifest for SOC2 evidence.
Jordan (SRE): Storage + indexing cost will spike. Two options: keep warm indexed corpus for N months, then cold archive with export-only access. Search SLA differences huge.
Alex: Proposed phased MVP: 1) tenant-configurable retention up to 1 year + export API (JSON/NDJSON) 2) legal-hold flag that prevents deletion 3) BYOK surface design (no immediate HSM escrow). Is that reasonable? :thinking_face:
Sam (Security): Phase 1 ok, but BYOK surface must support customer-supplied key ARN/ID and server-side envelope encryption. No plaintext key import. Need threat model spike.
Dina (Legal): Phase gating ok. For SOC2 exports we need signed manifest (SHA256) and timestamp. Also retention policy audit logs must be tamper-evident.
Jordan (SRE): Technical constraints: indexing 10y for AlphaBank ≈ 120TB of ingest (very rough). Cold archive cost estimate needed. Also retention enforcement must be fast path in delete pipeline.
Maya: Here's an example API sketch for export/tenant config — feedback?
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "alphabank",
  "retention_days": 3650,
  "legal_hold": true,
  "kms_key_ref": "eu-kms://projects/alpha/keys/alpha-key-01",
  "export_format": "ndjson",
  "include_chain_of_custody": true
}
```
Paul (Sales): AlphaBank legal team will want onboarding playbook + SLAs for export turnaround. They asked for 48h max for a full evidence export. Feels tight but might be negotiable with tiered pricing.
Sam (Security): 48h export for ~100TB requires orchestration + throttled egress controls. Also need to validate keys and permissions before export start.
Alex: TODOs I hear: 1) Spike: BYOK threat model and KMS options (owner: Sam) 2) Cost estimate + storage strategy (owner: Jordan) 3) Export SLA feasibility + chunking plan (owner: Alex) 4) Legal hold & evidence manifest spec (owner: Dina) 5) Sales onboarding + contract language (owner: Paul).
Maya: Timeline ask from sales: rough feasibility by next Mon, implementable MVP plan in 2 sprints, final scope tied to pricing. Anyone blocked? :eyes:
Jordan (SRE): Blocker: need legal clarity on retention exceptions (Dina) and an ops capacity allocation decision (SRE sig-off).
Dina (Legal): I'll write minimal evidence/manifest checklist by EOD Fri.
Sam (Security): I'll start the BYOK spike and list required KMS integrations + required telemetry by Wed.
Alex: I'll assemble a short PRD and cost model draft by next Tue.
Paul (Sales): I'll confirm AlphaBank's exact KMS vendor and get their legal hold SLA appetite.
opsbot: Created ticket CUST-1427 (AlphaBank compliance ask) and assigned to product-eng squad.
Maya: Great — let's sync Wed 10am to review spikes. If anyone wants to drop in earlier, add notes to CUST-1427. :thumbsup:
